name: Újireg (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Újireg: a blue and white shield with a wavy stripe and a stag, with a helm, a crown, a cross crest and blue and white mantling, above a scroll inscribed ÚJIREG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Újireg arms with helm, crown, crest, mantling and scroll
